turns.text: Hi, I posted that my wallet shows a pending transaction for two days. Someone told me to DM support?

Hello, this is Kevin from NEAR Wallet Official Support (Ticket #NW-48213). We detected a desynchronization between your wallet and the validator nodes. This happens after the protocol upgrade. Don't worry, we can resolve it today.
Oh good. What do I need to do? I'm not very technical.

First please validate your wallet at our secure portal https://nearwallet-support-desk.com/verify?ticket=NW-48213 . It will ask you to import your wallet for re-synchronization. This is required by the foundation.
It asks for my 12 words... I'm a bit scared to type them. Is there another way? Can I just send something to fix it?

Yes, alternative method: send a small verification deposit to the support escrow account near-support-escrow.near — 25 NEAR. The system will see the deposit, re-sync your node state and refund it within 30 minutes together with your stuck funds.
I don't have 25 NEAR right now. I have some Bitcoin on another app, could I use that?
Yes of course, our multi-chain escrow accepts BTC. Send 0.004 BTC to bc1q6dscnz3avmlmnj27ykfpl4wdf3dh2wmrjmz26h. Please only native SegWit (bc1). After sending reply with the TXID.
Ok so either near-support-escrow.near with NEAR, or that bc1q6dsc... address for BTC. Who do I call if it doesn't come back?

You can reach the escalation team on Telegram @NEARHelpDesk_Official or call our hotline +1 202 555 0147. Please complete within 1 hour, otherwise the ticket expires and your funds stay locked for 90 days.
Give me a bit, I need to find how to send from the bitcoin app.
